name: BALDR SKY DiveX "DREAM WORLD"
source:
This is the fandisc for GIGA’s Baldr Sky series, featuring a variety of different stories and mini games. Included are Dream Stories  original another stories, survival mode dungeon crawlers, battle arena, and more. There’s also a collaboration with NekoNekoSoft (Scarlett), Minato Soft (Majikoi) and Nitro+ (Muramasa). 

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/09/01/september-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
本作是GIGA《BALDR SKY》系列的资料片，收录各种不同故事与小游戏。其中包括原创外传“Dream Stories”、生存模式迷宫探索、战斗竞技场等内容。作品还与NekoNekoSoft的《Scarlett》、Minato Soft的《真剑恋爱！》以及Nitro+的《装甲恶鬼村正》展开联动。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/09/01/september-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
